summary: Kootenai NF 40-foot pole L-4 tower dated 1946 in Lincoln County, MT; listed gone by 1956. No source describes what remains at the site.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by 1956; no source describes what, if anything, remains at the site

events.note: Dated 1946 in the firelookout.com listing; no construction account found
Listed as gone in 1956; the listing does not say how

evidence.supports: six miles southwest of Thompson Lake
listed as a gone tower in Lincoln County

notes_for_editor: Two listings only, no register entry and no photo. Both list a gone tower at the record's coordinates (47.97590, -115.17933). Do not confuse with Davis Mountain Lookout (NHLR US 1505, MT 83), a standing tower in Lincoln County at about 48.505 N, 115.015 W. Record elevation_m is null; the listing gives 5,340 ft. height_m not set: 40 ft is the listed tower height, not confirmed as cab-floor height. Access and current condition unknown; no source found.
